=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

  PROBLEM: The regex-compile-failure warning uses print() without file=sys.stderr, so it emits to stdout.
  WHY: In `--list-violated-files` mode, stdout is consumed as a machine-readable file list by callers like review_conflict_prepare.sh, so the warning corrupts downstream allowlist expansion.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:965-977 | confidence=4

  WHY: Captured regex patterns and file paths can legitimately contain double-quote characters, which makes the structured PRE_EXISTING_FINGERPRINT_DRIFT_V1 marker syntactically ambiguous.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:959 | confidence=5

  WHY: The bootstrap order remains branch-copy-first, so stale integration branches keep running older copies of the scripts instead of picking up main-line fixes.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:878, 1199 | confidence=3

  WHY: When `--baseline-fingerprints-state` is used together with `--ref`, the baseline is captured from the working tree while compare_against_baseline verifies against the requested git tree.
